verdict.rationale: Jina Reader is an HTTP API service, so a downloadable machine-readable spec is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence documents no OpenAPI or equivalent spec, and a probe found every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404. The x-json-schema header is a content-extraction feature, not an API description, and the code builder is an interactive explorer, not a downloadable spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
